Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 5572 of 2025
Applicant :- Vinay Kumar
Opposite Party :- The State Of U.P. Thru. Its Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Nikhil Dixit

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Nikhil Dixit, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Manish Kumar Pandey,
the learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

2. Present petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C./Section 528 BNSS has been filed seeking quashing of the charge sheet dated 19.08.2022, summoning order dated 05.01.2023 along with entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.1299 of 2024, arising out of Case Crime No.260 of 2022, under Sections 406/420/506 I.P.C. Police Station Inayat Nagar, District Ayodhya, pending in the Court of learned Additional Civil Judge (Junior Division)-II/Judicial Magistrate, Faizabad.

entities.text: I.P.C. Police Station Inayat Nagar, District Ayodhya
entities.label: ORG

entities.text: Additional Civil Judge (Junior Division)-II/Judicial Magistrate, Faizabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.

3. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the aforesaid prayer and has submitted that while exercising the jurisdiction under Section 482 Cr.P.C., this Court cannot go into the correctness of the allegations Vinay Kumar vs The State Of U.P. Thru.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
. ... on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/120466031/
1 made against the applicant and has only to examine whether on the basis of the allegations made and material collected during investigation, the offences are made out against the applicant or not.
4. The Hon'ble Supreme Court in C.B.I. v. Aryan Singh, 2023 SCC Online SC 379 has held that while exercising the powers under Section 482 Cr.P.C., the Court is not required to conduct a mini trial.

entities.text: C.B.I. v. Aryan Singh, 2023 SCC Online SC 379
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It does not require the prosecution/investigating agency to prove the allegations.

While exercising the powers under Section 482 of the CrPC the Court has very limited jurisdiction and is required to consider "whether any sufficient material is available to proceed further against the accused for which the accused is required to be tried or not".
5.

Confronted with the aforesaid objection, the learned counsel for the applicant submits that he does not want to press this application on merit and he confines his prayer only to the extent that applicant may be permitted to surrender and move an application, before the court concerned seeking bail and suitable directions may be issued that same may be heard and decided expeditiously, in accordance to law.

6. Accordingly, the instant application is disposed of by observing that in case the applicant appears and file an application for his release on bail, the same shall be considered and decided expeditiously in accordance with law, including the law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Satender Kumar Antil v. C.B.I., (2022) 10 SCC 51.
.
